name: Elemental Conjurer
body:
Benefit(s): You may spontaneously convert any spell with the acid, cold, electricity, or fire descriptors into a summon monster spell of equal level. However, the only creatures that can be summoned are elementals whose type matches the descriptor as seen in Table: Elemental Conjurer.

Table: Elemental Conjurer
Descriptor	Elemental Summoned
Acid	Earth elemental
Cold	Water elemental
Electricity	Air elemental
Fire	Fire elemental

For example, a wizard could convert a fireball into a summon monster III spell used to summon 1d3 Small fire elementals.
